boundary: Failure of feasibility is not evidence that biological invariance or causal direction is absent; it prevents an invalid analysis on mismatched held artifacts.

minimum_acquisition.compartment: same purified MS-relevant compartment in every environment
minimum_acquisition.environments: at least three randomized or defensibly exogenous environments
minimum_acquisition.interventions: validated selective perturbations with measured off-target/collateral effects
minimum_acquisition.outcome: same molecular and functional outcome definition in every environment
minimum_acquisition.units: at least 30 independent donors per environment for initial estimation
minimum_acquisition.variables: same pre-specified globally disjoint HLA, IFN, lysosomal, and CD44/CXCR4 scores

purpose: V53 held-artifact feasibility audit for cross-environment causal invariance
